definitions.explanation: Having or giving more than enough; abundant in quantity or amount.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}はたっぷりある。
クリームをたっぷり{塗|ぬ}った。
たっぷり{寝|ね}たので{元気|げんき}だ。
examples.english: I slept plenty, so I feel great.

notes:
USAGE:
- たっぷり + verb: generously, plenty (adverb)
- たっぷりの + noun: plenty of, ample (adjectival)
- 〜がたっぷりある: there is plenty of ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- たっぷり{食|た}べる (to eat plenty)
- たっぷり{寝|ね}る (to sleep plenty)
- たっぷり{使|つか}う (to use generously)
- たっぷりの{野菜|やさい} (plenty of vegetables)

NUANCE: Conveys a sense of satisfaction and abundance. Often used when describing generous portions of food or having enough time/resources.
